### Two-way counter-proof
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Upgrade directly on the expired record: excluded by mid_year_upgrade_terms status table ("expired | not processed") and the plus_upgrade prerequisite sentence.
  - Renew at Heroes Club (customer is a veteran): excluded by status_verified_tiers_at_renewal §2 and lapsed_renewal_fee rule 1(a) ("A member's own statement of status is never recorded as verification").
  - Renew directly at Club Plus: lapsed_renewal_fee fixes the tier ("held at the tier the membership already has in every other case"; rule 1 converts to Club); no visible rule lets the renewal be taken at another chosen tier.
  - New year start 2026-10-05: excluded — payment within the 2-month anniversary period (renewal_dating boundary rule).
  - Upgrade fee from the timing doc's "difference in full" or pro-rata rows: excluded — 34 days ≤ 60 and first upgrade -> first row.
  - Northgate Visa as tender: persona and plus_upgrade "The tender the member chooses".
- "Do only the one thing asked" (upgrade only) is excluded by visible rules + records: status expired -> upgrade "not processed"; the prerequisite sentence ties the upgrade fee to an active membership with a current-year renewal fee recorded — neither holds. Excluded by reasoning, not by any route sentence.
- Fall-back numbers: renewal 65.00 vs 43.50; upgrade 65.00 vs 61.25 — both definite and different.
- Factor findability: every factor document listed in item 4 was reached from record words (expiry_date/status, duplicate_charge refund, card account product/status, eligibility_verified_through, opened_date, 45.50 fee charges, Purchases & Returns sale lines, term_start_date).
